visual.title: Rotating a shape about the origin
visual.caption: Drag to rotate or change the angle: every vertex turns by the same angle, side lengths stay fixed, and the determinant stays 1.

predict.question: A rotation changes position and orientation. What does it leave unchanged?
predict.explain: A rotation is an isometry with determinant 1, so every length and the enclosed area survive it.
